title: Counting surface subgroups in cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds
summary: Let $M =\mathbb{H}^3/Γ$ be a finite-volume, noncompact hyperbolic 3-manifold. We show that the number of quasi-Fuchsian surface subgroups of $Γ$ (up to conjugacy and commensurability) of genus at most $g$ is bounded both above and below by functions of the form $(cg)^{2g}$. As a corollary, for all $h\geq 4$, the number of purely pseudo-Anosov closed surface subgroups of genus at most $g$ of the mapping class group $\mathrm{Mod}(S_{h,0})$ is bounded below by $(Cg)^{2g}$ for a universal constant $C$.
